text:
Maya Chen: CI alert - nightly-smallbatch p95 +15% vs baseline, started ~01:00. Quick glance at perf output shows a heap alloc hotspot during decode path. Suspect GC/alloc pattern change. Attaching initial notes.
ci-agent: alert: nightly-smallbatch failed p95 +15% (job: nightly-smallbatch-20260318-077). See logs: /ci/jobs/nightly-smallbatch-077 (retention 7d)
Ethan R.: can you paste the commit range that landed before the spike? any big refactors?
Maya Chen: range looks like abc1234..def5678 — two merges: one is a small allocator tweak (PR 432) and another is a batching reorder (PR 434). No obvious change to runtime GC.
Priya S.: can we get a heap profile + flamegraph from the failing run? if it's allocator churn we'd see stacks with repeated mallocs. Also capture jemalloc stats if possible.
Maya Chen: yes. repro command I used locally (fast):
```
./bench_runner --suite=smallbatch --commit=def5678 --profile=heap --out=heap.def5678.pprof
perf record -g -o perf.def5678.data ./bench_runner --suite=smallbatch
```
Also capture `jeprof --alloc_objects heap.def5678.pprof > flame.def5678.svg` and `cat /proc/<pid>/status` for rss.
Lars: I can spin up a k10-small to run that tonight. tagging me if you want run creds. Which seed/inputs?
Maya Chen: use seed=42, inputset=small-random-1. target config: `--batch=8 --max_len=512` to match nightly.
Ethan R.: I'll try a quick bisect across abc1234..def5678 tomorrow morning. Who has the perf harness path? job name?
Maya Chen: job is nightly-smallbatch-20260318-077, the harness is infra/bench/runner:run_smallbatch in CI. Logs at the path ci-agent posted.
Priya S.: if you run bisect, please capture jemalloc stats and GC pause distribution. On Linux we can enable MALLOC_CONF: "metadata_thp:0,stats_print:true" and `RUST_LOG=alloc=info` in case runtime prints allocs.
Lars: running now on k10-small, will push artifacts to /artifacts/nightly/4187652100/ — will ping here with links.
ci-agent: info: previous baseline (abc1234) run p95 120ms, current (def5678) p95 138ms.
Ethan R.: delta ~15%. ok. plan: 1) reproduce with heap profile (Lars), 2) bisect (Ethan), 3) if bisect points to PR 432 (allocator tweak) we either revert or change jemalloc conf. Priya will prepare quick patch to flip jemalloc flags.
Priya S.: I can have a test patch that sets MALLOC_CONF to disable tcache for nightly; small change to test impact. Will open PR and link it here.
Maya Chen: sounds good. FYI: I saw repeated stack traces at runtime::decode::parse -> alloc::vec::Vec::grow in flamegraph, so looks like churn during token expansion.
Lars: upload done: /artifacts/nightly/4187652100/heap.def5678.pprof and flame.def5678.svg. quick preview: lots of allocs at decode path like Maya said.
Ethan R.: starting bisect now, will report snapshot commits and timings. ETA ~45m.
Maya Chen: thanks all. please add :eyes: or :thumbsup: on the PRs so we can fast-track if confirmed.
ci-agent: update: bisect job queued (job: bisect-nightly-4187652100). Will post results in thread when done.
Priya S.: if bisect implicates batching reorder (PR 434) that's fine too — I have alternative batching implementation to test. either way we should gate a revert fast if p95 regresses in prod.
Ethan R.: bisect found first bad commit abcdef1 (belongs to PR 432 allocator tweak). p95 on that commit is 136ms. previous good commit abc1234 is 120ms.
Maya Chen: ok, PR 432 it is. Priya can you open a revert or patch to flip MALLOC_CONF for nightly? We'll run a quick smoke.
Priya S.: opening revert PR now: PR 450 - revert allocator tweak + set MALLOC_CONF=test. Posting link in 2m.
Lars: rolling the revert into a canary run on k10-small.
Maya Chen: running validation; if canary looks good we'll promote and schedule full-nightly re-run. thanks team :thumbsup:
Ethan R.: noted for postmortem: add a small benchmark in CI to exercise decode churn to catch this earlier.
ci-agent: final: canary run p95=121ms, revert looks to fix the regression. Closing alert.
